purpose: The iig3d skill turns a short brief into a content spec and a persisted prompt file without calling the image API.
prompt: Use the iig3d skill (skills/iig3d/SKILL.md). Brief: a four-step software release process: Plan, Build, Verify, Ship, each with a one-line detail. Write the content spec to evals/out/release.yaml with style 3d-slab-stack and layout hierarchical-layers, then run `uv run skills/iig3d/scripts/iig3d.py prompt --spec evals/out/release.yaml --out-dir evals/out` and report the prompt_file path from its JSON. Do not run render and do not ask questions.
